headline: COP31 Climate Conference Opens with Green Investment Announcements
summary: The first week of the COP31 UN climate talks in Antalya featured green investment commitments and biodiversity declarations, including Papua New Guinea joining 25 nations in the Wildlife for Climate Declaration.
why: UN COP summits set international emissions standards and channel climate transition financing across member states.
